fieldValues.title: Closure obligations
fieldValues.decision_question: What specific obligations do we commit to if and when the project closes?
fieldValues.context: The founding meeting discussed the importance of being honest with artists about what happens if the project ends. Article A-006 states the constitutional commitment; this decision makes it operational and specific.
fieldValues.decision_statement: On closure the group commits to: (1) returning all artworks to their makers within 14 days of the closure decision; (2) making good all fixings and mounts within 28 days; (3) settling any outstanding commitments to artists before disbanding; (4) transferring any remaining group funds to the Party Utility. The Clerk records when each obligation is discharged.
fieldValues.rationale: Specific timelines make the commitment real. Without them, 'we will return work' is a statement of intent that can drift indefinitely.
